default.title: Try Python
default.instructions: Write some Python code and click Run.

debug01.title: Debug 1 — NameError
debug01.instructions: This program contains a mistake. Run it, read the error message carefully, and fix the program.
debug01.hint: Look carefully at the names used in the program.

debug02.title: Debug 2 — TypeError
debug02.instructions: This program contains a mistake involving data types. Run it and use the error message to help find the problem.
debug02.code:
age = 14

print("Next year you will be " + age + 1)
debug02.hint: Look at the types of the things being joined together.

debug03.title: Debug 3 — IndexError
debug03.instructions: This program contains a mistake involving a list. Run it and use the traceback to work out what went wrong.
debug03.hint: Look carefully at which positions actually exist in the list.

multiple_input.title: Input Practice
multiple_input.instructions: This program asks for two pieces of information. Enter the answers in the Program input box before clicking Run.
multiple_input.code:
name = input("What is your name? ")
age = input("How old are you? ")
print("Hello", name)
print("You are", age, "years old.")
